content.short: Bitrefill lets people spend crypto on gift cards, prepaid cards, eSIMs and phone top-ups in 180+ countries.
content.description: Bitrefill has accepted crypto since 2014 and makes it easy to spend in daily life. Customers pay in Bitcoin, over Lightning, or with ETH, SOL, USDC, USDT and other tokens. In return they get gift cards for thousands of brands such as Amazon, Apple and Uber, prepaid Visa and Mastercard cards, travel eSIMs and mobile refills. Codes usually arrive within seconds, and some purchases earn Bitcoin back. Its catalogue now covers categories from groceries and gasoline to travel and gaming, and an in-app assistant helps users find the right card or refill.
content.meta: Pay with Bitcoin, Lightning or stablecoins for gift cards, eSIMs and top-ups in 180+ countries. Explore Bitrefill on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
